metadata.description: Open-source Claude Code plugins from Mint Security

plugins.name: dividend
plugins.description: Make sense of your Claude Code session's context, prompt cache, and usage limits through quick tips and short lessons. Insights come from what Claude Code reports; everything stays within your machine.

plugins.name: pair
plugins.description: Share your Claude Code session with someone, peer to peer with no backend: they watch it live, drawn the way Claude Code draws it, and can talk to your Claude under their own name. It runs over a private Syncthing the plugin downloads on first use; no account needed.
